package targetcatalog_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/targetcatalog"
)

func TestResolvePreservesRequestOrderAndReportsExactMissingVersions(t *testing.T) {
	catalog := &catalogStub{found: []domain.TargetRef{
		{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "go.http-service", Version: "v1"},
	}}
	result, err := (targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: catalog}).Handle(context.Background(), []domain.TargetRef{
		{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "Go.Errors", Version: "V2"},
		{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "go.http-service", Version: "v1"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.Resolved) != 1 || result.Resolved[0].Key != "go.http-service" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected resolved targets: %#v", result.Resolved)
	}
	if len(result.Missing) != 1 || result.Missing[0].Key != "go.errors" || result.Missing[0].Version != "v2" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected missing targets: %#v", result.Missing)
	}
}

func TestResolveRejectsDuplicateExactIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	ref := domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	_, err := (targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: &catalogStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), []domain.TargetRef{ref, ref})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("error=%v, want validation", err)
	}
}

func TestResolveRejectsRepositoryIdentityOutsideRequest(t *testing.T) {
	catalog := &catalogStub{found: []domain.TargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.other", Version: "v1"}}}
	_, err := (targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: catalog}).Handle(context.Background(), []domain.TargetRef{
		{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("error=%v, want validation", err)
	}
}

type catalogStub struct {
	found []domain.TargetRef
}

func (stub *catalogStub) ResolveExact(context.Context, []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetRef, error) {
	return stub.found, nil
}
